notes: Counts are vulnerable package entries, not 48 independent protocol exploits or 48 unique advisories.
The production ethers package has no direct entry in this audit output.
Ganache is test tooling despite being listed in dependencies; solc 0.8.26 is the retained production compiler.
Hardhat-only findings are development-toolchain risks. adm-zip and undici advisories require untrusted archive or network input paths not exercised by the in-process audit.
tmp advisories affect the solc build toolchain; compiler input and local filesystem access are required. solc was not upgraded because the audit intentionally tests 0.8.26 bytecode.
No dependency advisory was promoted to a protocol vulnerability without a reachable code path and a reproduction.
